meta.title: Unit 3: My School
meta.grammar: There be 句型 + 方位表达 across from / behind / between
objectives: 能正确使用 There is / There are
能用 across from / behind / between 描述位置

vocab.ex: There is a big library in our school.
The lab is across from the hall.
The garden is behind the library.
The hall is between the lab and the office.

story.contentZh: 新同学迷路了。你要用 There be 和方位词准确描述学校各个地方，帮他找到秘密花园。
story.contentEn: A new student is lost. Use There be and prepositions of place to give directions.

nodes.title: 图书馆位置
nodes.text: 新同学问：「学校有图书馆吗？」

options.text: There is a big library in our school.
options.feedback: 📚 正确！There is + 单数名词。

options.text: There have a library in school.
options.feedback: ❌ There be 句型不能用 have。这是中国学生最高频错误之一。

options.text: Have a library in our school.
options.feedback: ❌ 缺少 There。完整结构是 There is/are...

nodes.title: 科学楼对面
nodes.text: 继续指路：科学楼在操场对面。

options.text: The science building is across from the sports field.
options.feedback: 🏫 找到了！across from = 在……对面。

options.text: The science building across the sports field.
options.feedback: ❌ 缺少 be 动词 is；across 后通常加 from。

options.text: The science building is between the sports field.
options.feedback: ❌ between 需要两个参照物（between A and B）。

nodes.title: 秘密花园
nodes.text: 最后线索：图书馆后面有一个安静的花园。

options.text: There is a quiet garden behind the new library.
options.feedback: 🌿 校园寻宝完成！There is + 事物 + 地点状语。

options.text: There have a quiet garden at behind library.
options.feedback: ❌ 又是 There have 错误；behind 前也不需要 at。

options.text: Library behind has a quiet garden.
options.feedback: ❌ 语序和结构都不对。优先使用 There is...

speaking.en: There is a big library in our school.
speaking.zh: 我们学校有一个大图书馆。

speaking.en: The sports field is behind the teaching building.
Is there a computer room on the third floor?
Our school is modern and beautiful.
speaking.zh: 我们学校既现代又漂亮。

speaking.en: The hall is between the lab and the office.
speaking.zh: 大厅在实验室和办公室之间。

grammarTip.summary: There is + 单数，There are + 复数。across from = 在……对面。
commonErrors: There have a library... → 应改为 There is a library...
The building across the field. → 缺少 is，且应用 across from
